w:r.w:t: The system uses 14 User-Defined Tables (UDTs) in SAP Business One, with direct HANA database integration for optimized performance. All tables follow SAP B1 naming conventions with @ prefix.
Main table for contract master data. Table Code: @RVCM_CNTRCT
Contract line items for services, materials, or milestones. Table Code: @RVCM_CNTRCT1
Interim Certificate Payment header for progressive billing. Table Code: @RVCM_ICP
Detailed line items for each ICP showing work progress. Table Code: @RVCM_ICP1
Payment milestones and schedules. Table Code: @RVCM_PYMSCH
Tracks retention amounts and releases. Table Code: @RVCM_RETEN
Various deductions applied to contracts or ICPs. Table Code: @RVCM_DEDUCT
Type: Advance, Penalty, Material, Insurance, Other
Tracks workflow state changes and approvals. Table Code: @RVCM_WFHIST
Action: Created, Submitted, Approved, Rejected, Modified
Manages performance bonds and bank guarantees. Table Code: @RVCM_GUARNT
Type: Performance, Advance Payment, Retention, Warranty

The following validation rules must be enforced at the data layer:
Contract end date must be after start date
Contract value must be greater than zero
Business partner must exist and be active
Contract must have at least one line item
Tax rate must be between 0 and 100
Status transitions must follow workflow rules
ICP must reference an active contract
Period end date must be after period start date
Cumulative quantity cannot exceed contract quantity
This period quantity must be greater than zero
Retention percentage must be between 0 and 100
Cannot create ICP for completed contract
Item code must exist in item master
Quantity must be greater than zero
Discount percentage must be between 0 and 100
Tax code must be valid and active
Currency must be active in system
All monetary amounts must have correct decimal precision
Total deductions cannot exceed gross value
VAT calculation must match tax code definition
Contracts progress through the following states:
Initial creation, can be edited freely
Approved and active, can create ICPs
Temporarily suspended, no new ICPs allowed
Draft → Active: Requires approval by authorized user
Active → On Hold: Can be done by manager at any time
On Hold → Active: Requires reason and approval
Active → Completed: Only when all work is done and final payment made
Any State → Cancelled: Requires high-level approval and cancellation reason
Completed/Cancelled: Cannot be changed back to other states
The ICP calculation follows this sequence:
Calculate Gross Value: Sum of (This Period Qty × Unit Price) for all lines
Deduct Advance Payment: Subtract any advance payment deduction
Calculate Retention: Multiply remaining amount by retention percentage
Deduct Materials: Subtract material deduction if applicable
Deduct Other: Subtract any other deductions
Calculate VAT: Apply tax rate to subtotal after all deductions
Net Payment: Subtotal after deductions + VAT amount
System tracks cumulative quantities for each contract line item
Previous Qty = Sum of all previous ICP quantities for this line
Cumulative Qty = Previous Qty + This Period Qty
User creates contract in Draft status
User submits for approval, status remains Draft, ApprovalStatus = Pending
Approver reviews contract details and financial impact
If approved: Status = Active, ApprovalStatus = Approved
If rejected: Status = Draft, ApprovalStatus = Rejected (user can revise and resubmit)
System logs all approval actions in workflow history
Project engineer creates ICP in Draft status
Project manager reviews work completion and values
If approved: Status = Approved, system auto-generates AR Invoice
If rejected: Status = Rejected, engineer revises and resubmits
Once invoice is paid: Status = Paid
When ICP is approved, system automatically creates AR Invoice:
Payment Terms: From Business Partner master data
Invoice Lines: One line per ICP line item with this period value
Deductions: Added as negative lines or separate deduction lines
Tax: Applied according to contract tax code
Reference: ICP number stored in user field
Retention amount is calculated but not invoiced
System tracks cumulative retention in RVCM_RETEN table
When contract is completed, retention can be released
Release creates a separate AR Invoice for retained amounts
System links ICPs to AR Invoices (U_InvoiceEntry)
When payment is received, status updates to Paid
Dashboard shows payment status and outstanding balances
Specifies reason, value change, and/or time extension
Amendment requires approval before taking effect
Upon approval, system updates contract values/dates
Original values preserved in amendment history
Amendment impacts all future ICPs automatically
Cannot delete contract with approved ICPs
Cannot create ICP for non-Active contract
Cannot exceed 100% completion on any line item
Cumulative payment cannot exceed contract total value
Must have at least one approved ICP before marking contract Completed
Retention release requires completion of contract or specific milestone
All amounts must be in contract currency

The Interim Payment Certificate (IPC) module manages progressive payment requests based on work completion. It is essential for construction, engineering, and project-based contracts where payments are made in stages rather than lump sum.
Progressive payment tracking based on work completion percentage
Automatic A/R Invoice generation upon approval

This document addresses six critical mathematical errors identified in the ICP calculation process and provides corrected formulas and implementation guidance.
The original calculation applied retention after other deductions, which is mathematically incorrect. Retention should be calculated on the gross value before other deductions.

Step 1: RetentionAmount = GrossValue * (RetentionPct / 100) Step 2: Subtotal = GrossValue - AdvanceDeduct - RetentionAmount - MaterialDeduct - OtherDeduct Step 3: VATAmount = Subtotal * (TaxRate / 100) Step 4: NetPayment = Subtotal + VATAmount
Percentage completion calculation can cause division by zero if Contract Quantity is zero or null.
IF ContractQty > 0 THEN PctComplete = (CumulativeQty / ContractQty) * 100 ELSE PctComplete = 0 END IF
CASE WHEN COALESCE("U_ContractQty", 0) > 0 THEN ("U_CumQty" / "U_ContractQty") * 100 ELSE 0 END AS "PctComplete"
No clear rounding rules defined for financial calculations, leading to penny differences in totals.
All monetary amounts must be rounded to 2 decimal places
Round after EACH calculation step, not just final result
Percentages stored with 6 decimal precision but displayed as 2
ROUND(GrossValue * RetentionPct / 100, 2) AS RetentionAmount ROUND(Subtotal * TaxRate / 100, 2) AS VATAmount ROUND(Subtotal + VATAmount, 2) AS NetPayment
Retention release calculation doesn't account for partial releases or multiple release events.

TotalRetained = SUM(All ICP Retention Amounts for Contract) TotalReleased = SUM(All Retention Releases for Contract) RetentionBalance = TotalRetained - TotalReleased AvailableForRelease = MIN(RetentionBalance, ReleasableAmount)
Cannot release more than total retained
Each release must reference specific ICPs
System tracks cumulative releases per contract
Partial releases require approval and justification
System doesn't validate that cumulative payments don't exceed contract value.

TotalBilled = SUM(All Approved ICP Net Payments) ContractTotal = Contract Total Value (including tax) RemainingValue = ContractTotal - TotalBilled IF (NewICPNetPayment > RemainingValue) THEN RAISE ERROR "ICP amount exceeds remaining contract value" SHOW WARNING "Remaining: " + RemainingValue END IF

SELECT c."U_TotalValue" AS "ContractTotal", COALESCE(SUM(i."U_NetPayment"), 0) AS "TotalBilled", (c."U_TotalValue" - COALESCE(SUM(i."U_NetPayment"), 0)) AS "Remaining" FROM "@RVCM_CNTRCT" c LEFT JOIN "@RVCM_ICP" i ON c."Code" = i."U_ContractCode" AND i."U_Status" IN ('A', 'P') WHERE c."Code" = ? GROUP BY c."Code", c."U_TotalValue";
No exchange rate handling when contract currency differs from local currency.
Store all amounts in contract currency
Fetch exchange rate from ORTT table at transaction date
Calculate local currency equivalent for reporting
Display both currencies in UI with exchange rate

SELECT i."U_NetPayment" AS "AmountFC", i."U_Currency" AS "Currency", r."Rate" AS "ExchangeRate", ROUND(i."U_NetPayment" * r."Rate", 2) AS "AmountLC", sys."MainCurncy" AS "LocalCurrency" FROM "@RVCM_ICP" i INNER JOIN "ORTT" r ON i."U_Currency" = r."Currency" AND r."RateDate" <= i."U_CertDate" CROSS JOIN "OADM" sys WHERE i."Code" = ? ORDER BY r."RateDate" DESC LIMIT 1;
